title: Round 6: the gated DAgger student at teacher gain 0.5, sharpened, trained longer and on its own policy
description: Round 5t's gated students at teacher gain 0.5, sharpened at t = 0.5 (exp-net2-gate-r5t-117), met every gate condition but copies: +0.096 (+0.052 to +0.143) with Cubic from the start, +0.036 (+0.002 to +0.068) in the competition conditions, five-family mean +0.025, copies -0.104 (-0.171 to -0.048). The copies loss tracked how well each seed told the cases apart in training: the seed whose p was 0.78 with a stock TCP flow and 0.13 otherwise lost 0.02 to the rule as copies, the two whose p elsewhere was 0.44 and 0.47 lost 0.13 to 0.16. Two ways to separate better run here, both with the switch sharpened at t = 0.5 during training too, so DAgger's data come from the policy that would be deployed: start r5 continues each round-5 seed's student (release model-net2-r5-actors, PPOSpec init_actor) for 60 more iterations at learning rate 3e-4; start new trains a student from the rule at learning rate 1e-3. Otherwise as round 5: teacher gain 0.5, 32 links of one rollout per iteration, a replay of 16 iterations, about one pass per iteration, the competition mix, sigma = 0.05, seeds 1, 2 and 3. The policies (exported with the threshold) go to the round-6 gate. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25
run: S="$OUT/spec-r6-$START-s$SEED.json"; jq --arg start "$START" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg init "$IN/a/ppo-r5gate-k0.5-s$SEED.actor.pt" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = "gate" | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = 0.5 | .gate_threshold = 0.5 | .critic_warmup = 0 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20 | (if $start == "r5" then .init_actor = $init | .lr = 0.0003 else .lr = 0.001 end)' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r6-$START-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
